title: White Rice with Carrots, Fat Added

content.title: About
content.content: A ready‑to‑eat product consisting of boiled white rice mixed with finely diced carrots and added vegetable fat. It is commonly used in baby foods and in diets that require higher energy density.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: White rice provides quickly digestible carbohydrates, making it a good energy base.
Carrots add beta‑carotene, a precursor of vitamin A.
The added fat increases caloric content and helps absorb fat‑soluble vitamins.
Traditionally used in infant nutrition for babies from 6 months old.
When stored properly, the product remains fresh for up to 12 months.

items.title: Rapid energy source
items.content: White rice is quickly converted to glucose, delivering fast‑acting energy for active children and athletes.

items.title: Supports vision
items.content: Beta‑carotene from carrots converts to vitamin A, essential for eye health and immunity.

items.title: Improved vitamin absorption
items.content: Added vegetable fat enhances the absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K).

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Well‑cooked rice and soft carrots make the product gentle on the stomach, suitable for infants and those with digestive issues.

items.title: Balanced macronutrients
items.content: The combination of carbs, a modest amount of fat, and some protein provides sustained satiety.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: White rice has a high glycemic index, which can cause rapid blood sugar spikes in people with diabetes.

items.title: Allergy to vegetable oils
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to the specific vegetable oil used.

items.title: Arsenic content
items.content: Rice can contain trace amounts of arsenic; a varied diet is recommended.

items.title: Potential over‑consumption
items.content: Due to its high calorie density, portion control is important, especially for children.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve as a standalone dish, add to soups, stews, or use as a side for meat and fish. It reheats well in the microwave or on the stovetop, stirring to prevent sticking.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a sealed package in a cool, dry place. After opening, use within 3‑4 days, or store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks for longer shelf life.
